description: Text classification competition where many train texts were duplicated in test. Winners deduplicated and used source-based splits; default random KFold inflated CV.

competition_input.title: Multilingual Support Ticket Classification (with duplicates)
competition_input.description: Classify customer support tickets into 12 categories. Train and test overlap by ~5% (near-duplicates). Test set is held-out.

known_outcome.lesson: Dedup first, then build CV. Several top teams shared the same deduplication trick.
